name.from: Contra 1.Cf3 y 1.c4: esquema del Gambito de Dama

summary.from: Contra la Réti (1.Cf3) y la Inglesa (1.c4) usas las mismas piezas en las mismas casillas que en el Gambito de Dama rehusado: ...d5, ...e6, ...Cf6, ...Ae7 y enroque.
summary.to: Against the Réti (1.Nf3) and the English (1.c4) you put the same pieces on the same squares as in the Queen’s Gambit Declined: ...d5, ...e6, ...Nf6, ...Be7 and castling.

steps.0.note.from: La Réti: las blancas desarrollan antes de mover un peón central.
steps.0.note.to: The Réti: White develops before moving a central pawn.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: La Inglesa: el peón de c vigila d5 desde un lado.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: The English: the c-pawn watches d5 from the side.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Preparas ...d5 para que, si cambian en d5, recuperes con un peón.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You prepare ...d5 so that, if they exchange on d5, you recapture with a pawn.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan y vigilan d5.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas desarrollan el caballo de rey.
Ocupas el centro: tu esquema de siempre.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You occupy the centre: your usual setup.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en g2.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White prepares the bishop on g2.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El alfil blanco presiona d5 desde lejos.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The white bishop puts pressure on d5 from afar.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas preparan el otro alfil en b2.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White prepares the other bishop on b2.
You gain space and watch d4.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Los dos alfiles blancos miran al centro desde los lados.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: Both white bishops eye the centre from the sides.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Desarrollo completo de tus piezas menores.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: Your minor pieces are fully developed.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.1.st.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en g2.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.1.st.to: White prepares the bishop on g2.
The bishop puts pressure on d5.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.1.st.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en b2.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.2.branches.1.st.to: White prepares the bishop on b2.
You gain space in the centre.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Ocupas el centro, apoyado por el peón de e6.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You occupy the centre, supported by the e6 pawn.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas también ocupan el centro: es un Gambito de Dama por otro orden.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: White occupies the centre too: it is a Queen’s Gambit by a different move order.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas cambian en el centro.
Recuperas con el peón: por eso jugaste antes ...e6.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You recapture with the pawn: that is why you played ...e6 first.
You break the pin by developing.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas abren paso a su otro alfil.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: White opens the way for their other bishop.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.from: Refuerzas d5: es la variante del cambio del Gambito de Dama.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.4.branches.0.st.to: You reinforce d5: this is the Exchange Variation of the Queen’s Gambit.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Rompes la clavada y preparas el enroque.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You break the pin and prepare castling.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su alfil de f1.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: White opens the way for their f1 bishop.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.10.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan el último caballo.

steps.0.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Ya estás en la línea principal del Gambito de Dama rehusado.
steps.0.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You are now in the main line of the Queen’s Gambit Declined.

steps.1.note.from: Ocupas el centro con el peón de dama.
steps.1.note.to: You occupy the centre with the queen’s pawn.

steps.2.note.from: Las blancas presionan tu peón de d5 desde un lado.
steps.2.note.to: White puts pressure on your d5 pawn from the side.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en g2.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: White prepares the bishop on g2.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: El alfil blanco mira al centro.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The white bishop eyes the centre.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Tu esquema de siempre: abres paso al alfil de f8.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: Your usual setup: you open the way for the f8 bishop.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: El caballo apoya el avance e4.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: The knight supports the e4 advance.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Ganas espacio en el flanco de dama.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You gain space on the queenside.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Desarrollas y vigilas d4 y e5.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You develop and watch d4 and e5.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.2.note.from: Ahora sí, el Gambito de Dama.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.2.note.to: Now it is the Queen’s Gambit.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.6.note.to: The bishop comes out to g5.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.8.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su alfil.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.8.note.to: White opens the way for their bishop.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.from: Misma posición que en el Gambito de Dama rehusado.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.to: The same position as in the Queen’s Gambit Declined.

steps.3.note.from: Sostienes d5 con un peón, igual que contra el Gambito de Dama.
steps.3.note.to: You hold d5 with a pawn, just as against the Queen’s Gambit.

steps.4.note.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en g2.
steps.4.note.to: White prepares the bishop on g2.

steps.6.note.from: El alfil blanco presiona d5 desde lejos.
steps.6.note.to: The white bishop puts pressure on d5 from afar.

steps.10.note.from: Las blancas preparan el otro alfil en b2.
steps.10.note.to: White prepares the other bishop on b2.

steps.11.note.to: You gain space and watch d4.

steps.12.note.from: Los dos alfiles blancos miran al centro desde los lados.
steps.12.note.to: Both white bishops eye the centre from the sides.

steps.15.note.from: Preparas tu alfil en b7 para contestar al de g2.
steps.15.note.to: You prepare your bishop on b7 to answer the one on g2.
